They also feature mp3 player compatible stereos with CD players to make it easy for you to create the ideal ambiance for your experience. quotes.text: Girls trip out on the Duffy was a great reunion and Joe at Voyagers was a super helpful, friendly owner. The boat was clean and a little slow but that didn’t really bother us because you can’t beat the view on Newport Bay. Joe was very understanding and helpful when we got slightly lost and gave great directions so that we got back quickly! What a great and fun way to spend your day!

We decided to rent out a duffy boat, and it was extremely easy booking it online through Voyagers Rentals. I liked that they put clear instructions on where to park or what to expect. The boat was also very clean and the price was reasonable for 2 hours on the duffy. My friends and I had a ton of fun! Will definitely come back again if we’re on balboa island 🙂

We rented a duffy boat from this company several times. They are family owned and wonderful people. Always quick to respond to any questions. Boats are clean and love options on a larger size if needed. Taking out a Duffy boat with visitors is so much fun. Voyagers make it an easy and pleasant experience.
Rented from dozens of companies before. This is one of the nicest cleanest most well run companies!!! We will only rent from this company from now on.
Great experience! I highly recommend this company, they are very nice and the duffy was perfect!! Thanks, Voyagers!!!
